name: VARoleInterpreterHoaOrMortgageLetter

custom.system_prompt: Yasmin and Cole, new homeowners, received a mortgage escrow adjustment letter full of unfamiliar terms about their monthly payment changing. They ask Sigma to help them understand why and what it means for their budget. Sigma clarifies without giving financial advice.

initial_prompt: Generate a scene where Yasmin and Cole, new homeowners, received a mortgage escrow adjustment letter explaining that their monthly payment is changing, full of unfamiliar escrow and impound terminology. They ask Sigma to help them understand why and what it means for their budget. Sigma explains the escrow terminology and the reason given for the adjustment, based on the actual letter, without giving financial advice about their broader budget. Keep every line short and natural.

user1.name: Yasmin
user1.tts_prompt: Precise, wants to understand the mechanism

user2.name: Cole
user2.tts_prompt: Practical, mainly wants the bottom-line number

variations.context: New homeowners confused by a mortgage escrow adjustment letter

setting.mood: Mildly concerned about the budget impact, curious about the mechanism
setting.relationship_dynamic: Couple working through a shared document together, then involving Sigma
setting.background: This is their first escrow adjustment as new homeowners and neither has encountered this terminology before
setting.conversation_style: Short exchanges, Yasmin curious about the why, Cole focused on the practical number

scenario_template.topic: Yasmin and Cole each react to the letter — Yasmin wanting to understand the escrow term, Cole just wanting to know the new payment amount. A couple of short lines.
scenario_template.note: Both reactions are reasonable and different.

scenario_template.topic: Yasmin asks Sigma to explain the escrow terms and why the payment is changing, addressing Sigma directly in one short line.
scenario_template.note: e.g. 'Sigma, can you explain what escrow adjustment means and why our payment is changing?'

scenario_template.topic: Sigma asks them to read out the specific reason given for the adjustment and the new payment amount, so it has the actual content.
scenario_template.note: Either partner reads specific text and numbers.

scenario_template.topic: Sigma explains what an escrow account is for and translates the specific stated reason for the adjustment — likely a property tax or insurance premium change — based on the actual letter.
scenario_template.note: This should reference their specific letter's stated reason and numbers.

scenario_template.topic: Sigma states the new monthly payment plainly and is explicit that whether this fits their budget or whether to contest the underlying tax/insurance figure is beyond what the letter itself can answer.
scenario_template.note: Sigma clarifies the letter; budget planning is their own decision.

scenario_template.topic: Yasmin and Cole both understand the mechanism now and agree to check their budget for the new amount. Keep this realistic — Cole is satisfied with the number, Yasmin still curious about the underlying tax change.
